english: Hand pose may provide a shared interface between electromyography (EMG) sensing and models trained on pose data. Yet an input that fits a model does not necessarily preserve its decisions. We investigate this gap using one frozen EMG-to-pose estimator and six frozen pose classifiers built from four public datasets. By comparing decisions on paired measured and estimated poses, we first quantify how often input substitution changes the outputs of unchanged classifiers. We then test whether learned offline ranking can preferentially retain decisions that match the measured-pose reference. Across 80 participants, full-feature ranking reduced median paired overall disagreement by 1.87--4.65 percentage points relative to boundary-based selection at 30\% retention. However, this overall improvement did not always extend to individual reference classes. For SHOW instruction, overall disagreement improved by 2.61 points while class-balanced disagreement worsened by 20.88 points among the same 79 evaluable participants. Selection also reduced evaluable class support in some consumers. These findings show that lower overall disagreement does not guarantee class-balanced decision preservation, motivating joint evaluation of overall disagreement, class-balanced disagreement, and reference-class support. The results characterize retrospective agreement with model-generated reference decisions, not independent action accuracy or validated online rejection.
chinese: 手部姿态有望成为肌电（EMG）感知与基于姿态数据训练的模型之间的共享接口。然而，模型能够接收一种输入，并不意味着其决策能够保持不变。我们采用一个冻结的EMG到姿态估计器，以及基于四个公开数据集建立的六个冻结姿态分类器，研究这一差距。通过比较配对的测量姿态与估计姿态所产生的决策，我们首先量化输入替换改变固定分类器输出的频率，再检验学习型离线排序能否优先保留与测量姿态参考一致的决策。在80名参与者中，保留率为30\%时，全特征排序相对于边界选择，将参与者内配对整体不一致率的中位数降低了1.87--4.65个百分点。然而，整体改善并不总能扩展到各个参考类别。在SHOW指令任务中，同一组79名可评价参与者的整体不一致率改善了2.61个百分点，类别平衡不一致率却恶化了20.88个百分点。选择还使部分消费者的可评价类别支持量减少。这些发现表明，更低的整体不一致率并不保证类别平衡的决策保持，因此应联合评价整体不一致率、类别平衡不一致率及参考类别支持量。这些结果描述的是与模型生成参考决策之间的回顾性一致性，而非独立动作准确率或已验证的在线拒判能力。

english: Electromyography (EMG) is commonly used to decode movement or gestures directly. An alternative is to estimate hand pose from EMG and pass that estimate to models already trained on pose data. But the input may be compatible in format without preserving the downstream model's decision.
chinese: 肌电（EMG）常用于直接解码运动或手势。另一种方式是先从EMG估计手部姿态，再将估计结果输入已经基于姿态数据训练的模型。然而，输入格式兼容并不保证下游模型的决策保持不变。

english: A fixed gesture classifier may predict class A from measured hand pose but class B from the corresponding EMG-estimated pose. We call this change a decision flip: input substitution changed the model's output, regardless of whether either prediction matches an independently labeled action. This motivates evaluating downstream decisions as well as pose reconstruction error.
chinese: 固定手势分类器可能根据测量手部姿态预测类别A，却根据对应的EMG估计姿态预测类别B。我们将这一变化称为决策翻转（flip）：输入替换改变了模型输出，无论任一预测是否与独立标注的动作相符。因此，除姿态重建误差之外，还需要评价下游决策。

english: Previous work has studied EMG-based pose estimation \cite{salter2024emg2pose}, pose-guided EMG representations \cite{cui2025cpep,cui2026embridge}, and rejection in myoelectric or selective prediction systems \cite{scheme2013confidence,ahkami2023rejection,geifman2019selectivenet}. Here, we keep the upstream estimator and downstream classifiers fixed.
chinese: 已有工作研究了EMG姿态估计\cite{salter2024emg2pose}、姿态引导的EMG表示\cite{cui2025cpep,cui2026embridge}，以及肌电或选择性预测系统中的拒判\cite{scheme2013confidence,ahkami2023rejection,geifman2019selectivenet}。本研究保持上游估计器和下游分类器固定。

english: We examine three connected questions: How often does pose substitution change frozen downstream decisions? Can offline ranking reduce these changes? And do improvements in overall agreement extend across reference classes? Our evaluation concerns output fidelity rather than independently verified action accuracy or online control.
chinese: 我们研究三个相互衔接的问题：姿态替换多频繁地改变冻结的下游决策？离线排序能否减少这些变化？整体一致性的改善能否扩展到各个参考类别？本研究评价输出保真，而非经过独立验证的动作准确率或在线控制。

english: A frozen pose consumer is a pose-based classifier whose parameters and source-fitted preprocessing remain unchanged. We pass measured pose and EMG-estimated pose through the same consumer and compare the resulting decisions. The upstream EMG-to-pose estimator is also frozen. Our six linear discriminant analysis (LDA) consumers cover posture and grasp classification from DB9 \cite{jarquebou2020db9} and CeTI-Age \cite{muschter2023ceti}, instruction classification from SHOW3D \cite{rim2026show3d}, and movement-phase classification from KIN-MUS UJI \cite{jarquebou2019kinmus}.
chinese: 冻结的姿态消费者是指参数及源域拟合预处理均保持不变的姿态分类器。我们将测量姿态与EMG估计姿态送入同一个消费者，并比较其决策。上游EMG到姿态估计器同样冻结。六个线性判别分析（LDA）消费者包括DB9\cite{jarquebou2020db9}和CeTI-Age\cite{muschter2023ceti}的姿态及抓握分类、SHOW3D\cite{rim2026show3d}的指令分类，以及KIN-MUS UJI\cite{jarquebou2019kinmus}的运动阶段分类。

english: The released VEMG2Pose estimator \cite{salter2024emg2pose} and each source consumer are connected using a fixed eight-joint pose adapter in radians. Joint selection, units, and available axis or topology information were audited. The paired target inputs use corresponding cached block indices after a common crop, with approximately 20-ms target blocks. These implementation checks do not independently establish identical physical joint zero positions or residual sensor synchronization across sources.
chinese: 发布的VEMG2Pose估计器\cite{salter2024emg2pose}通过固定的八关节姿态适配器与各源域消费者连接，单位为弧度。我们核查了关节选择、单位及可获得的轴或拓扑信息。配对目标输入在共同裁剪后采用对应的缓存块索引，目标块约为20 ms。这些实现检查并未独立证明不同来源具有相同的物理关节零位或残余传感器同步误差。

english: The original EMG-to-pose dataset documents individual calibration and software timestamp alignment \cite{salter2024emg2pose}. Cross-source physical equivalence remains a separate, unverified requirement.
chinese: 原EMG到姿态数据集记载了个体校准与软件时间戳对齐\cite{salter2024emg2pose}。跨源物理等价仍是另一项尚未验证的要求。

english: Six source-domain leave-one-subject-out evaluations were reproduced against the archived out-of-fold predictions. The corresponding balanced accuracies were 74.79\%, 85.50\%, 58.56\%, 72.25\%, 100\%, and 56.17\% for DB9 posture, DB9 grasp, CeTI posture, CeTI grasp, SHOW instruction, and KIN phase, respectively. The SHOW result covers 16 participants and 60 weak-instruction recordings. These tasks use different source labels and evaluation units, so their accuracies should not be interpreted as a common performance ranking.
chinese: 六项源域留一参与者交叉验证已复现，并与归档的折外预测核对一致。DB9姿态、DB9抓握、CeTI姿态、CeTI抓握、SHOW指令和KIN阶段的平衡准确率依次为74.79\%、85.50\%、58.56\%、72.25\%、100\%和56.17\%。SHOW结果的范围为16名参与者和60条弱指令记录。这些任务使用不同的源域标签与评价单位，不能据此将准确率解释为统一的性能排名。

english: The eight angles are thumb MCP/IP, index MCP/PIP, middle MCP, ring MCP, and little-finger MCP/PIP (target native indices 2, 3, 5, 6, 9, 13, 17, 18). Source-fitted standardization is held fixed. Target pose and reference streams share a 1790-row crop and nonoverlapping 40-row means, time-stamped at the block end. Source aggregation differs: CeTI averages 32 frames (nominally 0.808 s), whereas SHOW/KIN use approximately 0.8-s windows.
chinese: 八个角度为拇指MCP/IP、食指MCP/PIP、中指MCP、无名指MCP和小指MCP/PIP，目标原生索引为2、3、5、6、9、13、17、18。源域拟合的标准化保持固定。目标姿态与参考序列均裁去1790行，按不重叠的40行取均值，并以块末时刻记录时间戳。源域聚合方式不同：CeTI对32帧取均值，标称时长为0.808 s；SHOW/KIN采用约0.8 s窗口。

english: A flip records a change in the same frozen consumer's decision under pose substitution. Measured references identify flips during development and offline evaluation; ranking uses estimated-input features only. For consumer \(i\), participant \(u\), and block \(t\), measured pose \(q_{u,t}\) and estimated pose \(\hat q_{u,t}\) define
chinese: 翻转记录同一冻结消费者在姿态替换后的决策变化。测量参考用于开发和离线评价时识别翻转；排序仅使用估计输入特征。对于消费者\(i\)、参与者\(u\)和块\(t\)，由测量姿态\(q_{u,t}\)和估计姿态\(\hat q_{u,t}\)定义

english: We evaluate selection in two ways. Overall disagreement (U) is the proportion of retained, reference-valid blocks whose decisions differ. Coverage is the proportion of prediction-valid blocks retained.
chinese: 我们从两个方面评价选择。整体不一致率（U）为保留且参考有效的块中，两路决策不同的比例。覆盖率为预测有效块中被保留的比例。

english: Let \(V_u\) contain prediction-valid blocks, \(P_u\subseteq V_u\) those also having valid measured references, and \(A_u\subseteq V_u\) accepted blocks (consumer/method indices suppressed).
chinese: 令\(V_u\)表示预测有效块，\(P_u\subseteq V_u\)表示其中同时具有有效测量参考的块，\(A_u\subseteq V_u\)表示接受的块，省略消费者和方法索引。

english: Overall disagreement is undefined if \(A_u\cap P_u=\varnothing\). Missing-reference blocks contribute to coverage, but not to the observed disagreement denominator.
chinese: 当\(A_u\cap P_u=\varnothing\)时，整体不一致率未定义。缺少参考的块计入覆盖率，但不计入观测不一致率的分母。

english: The reference-class support set is
chinese: 参考类别支持集合为

english: Class-balanced disagreement (B) first calculates disagreement within each fixed measured-pose reference class and then averages those class rates equally. B is reported only when all fixed reference classes have at least 30 reference-valid blocks before selection and at least 30 retained blocks afterward. Otherwise B is undefined; unsupported classes are never silently excluded.
chinese: 类别平衡不一致率（B）先在每个固定测量姿态参考类别内计算不一致率，再对各类别等权平均。只有所有固定参考类别在选择前各有至少30个参考有效块，且选择后各保留至少30个块时，才报告B；否则B未定义，不能默默排除支持不足的类别。

english: Selection changes which estimated-input decisions are retained, not the classes predicted by the frozen consumer. We compare three ranking strategies. Boundary ranks inputs by their distance from the consumer's nearest competing decision boundary. Score-only uses the consumer's predicted class, discriminant scores, score gap, entropy, and boundary distance to learn flip risk. Full adds estimated-pose information and descriptors of variation across fixed EMG input views.
chinese: 选择改变的是哪些估计输入决策被保留，而不是冻结消费者预测的类别。我们比较三种排序策略。Boundary按输入距消费者最近竞争决策边界的距离排序。Score-only根据消费者的预测类别、判别分数、分数差、熵和边界距离学习翻转风险。Full进一步加入估计姿态信息，以及固定EMG输入视图之间的变化描述量。

english: For each consumer, the learned scorers are trained using paired development recordings with measured-pose flip labels. The primary overall-risk configuration uses histogram gradient boosting and is denoted Score-only/U or Full/U; /U marks the training objective, whereas U is the evaluated disagreement measure. A separate class-weighted configuration uses logistic regression to study balanced-risk training. During evaluation, all ranking features come from the estimated-input pathway; measured pose is used only to score the retrospective outcome.
chinese: 对每个消费者，学习型评分器均使用配对开发记录及测量姿态翻转标签训练。主要整体风险配置采用直方图梯度提升，记为Score-only/U或Full/U；/U标记训练目标，而U表示评价的不一致率指标。另一种采用类别权重的配置使用逻辑回归，研究平衡风险训练。评价时，所有排序特征均来自估计输入路径；测量姿态仅用于计算回顾性结果。

english: Fisher coordinates are the source-fitted LDA projection of standardized estimated pose. Full includes eight pose angles, these coordinates, and two descriptors from four fixed EMG views: original, 0.97/1.03 amplitude scaling, and deterministic Gaussian noise at 0.005 times whole-record RMS. Fitting uses up to 5000 deterministically sampled paired blocks per participant, with equal participant and within-participant flip-state weights for /U. Histogram gradient boosting uses 100 iterations, depth 3, learning rate 0.1, L2 penalty 1, and seed 0. The balanced configuration uses reference-class/flip-state weighting and standardized logistic regression (\(C=1\), 300 iterations, seed 0).
chinese: Fisher坐标是源域拟合LDA对标准化估计姿态的投影。Full包含八个姿态角、这些坐标，以及四种固定EMG视图的两个描述量：原始输入、0.97/1.03幅值缩放，以及标准差为完整记录RMS的0.005倍的确定性高斯噪声。每名参与者最多确定性抽取5000个配对块用于拟合，/U采用参与者等权及参与者内翻转状态权重。直方图梯度提升采用100轮、深度3、学习率0.1、L2惩罚1和随机种子0。平衡配置采用参考类别/翻转状态权重及标准化逻辑回归，\(C=1\)、最多300轮、随机种子0。

english: Our primary analysis compares methods at equal offline retention budgets. For each participant, inputs are ranked using estimated-input features and the top 10\%, 30\%, 50\%, or 70\% of prediction-valid blocks are retained, with deterministic tie handling. No Gate retains all prediction-valid blocks. Retention is defined on prediction-valid blocks, whereas disagreement requires valid paired references.
chinese: 主要分析在相同离线保留预算下比较方法。对每名参与者，依据估计输入特征排序，以确定性规则处理同分，保留预测有效块中排名前10\%、30\%、50\%或70\%的块。No Gate保留全部预测有效块。保留率以预测有效块定义，而不一致率需要有效配对参考。

english: Because each participant is ranked using their own full-record score distribution, this protocol measures retrospective ranking rather than a deployable common threshold. A separate development-selected fixed-threshold audit evaluates whether predefined disagreement and coverage requirements can be met without choosing thresholds on the evaluation cohort.
chinese: 由于每名参与者均依据其完整记录的分数分布独立排序，该协议测量的是回顾性排序能力，而非可部署的统一阈值。另行开展的开发集选定固定阈值审计，评价能否在不根据评价队列选择阈值的条件下满足预设不一致率和覆盖率要求。

english: Nineteen development participants comprise 13 fitting, three threshold-selection, and three diagnostic-validation participants. Validation affects neither fitting nor threshold selection. Stable score ordering with fixed file/block order resolves ties; a budget \(r\) retains \(\lceil r|V_u|\rceil\) blocks. Threshold feasibility requires disagreement \(\leq10\%\) for every threshold-development participant and median coverage \(\geq10\%\); the balanced objective also requires complete class support. Infeasible settings use the prespecified 30\% diagnostic fallback without being counted as feasible.
chinese: 19名开发参与者中，13名用于拟合，三名用于阈值选择，三名用于诊断验证；验证不影响拟合或阈值选择。固定文件/块顺序的稳定排序处理同分；预算\(r\)保留\(\lceil r|V_u|\rceil\)个块。阈值可行性要求每名阈值开发参与者的不一致率均\(\leq10\%\)，且覆盖率中位数\(\geq10\%\)；平衡目标还要求完整类别支持。不可行配置采用预先规定的30\%诊断回退，但不计为可行。

english: The two previously examined evaluation cohorts comprise A20 (20 participants; 1,650,789 valid measured--estimated pairs) and N80 (80 participants; 7,111,408 pairs). They are analyzed separately and are not treated as independent confirmation after repeated examination. Participants used for selection-scorer development are separate from the reported evaluation participants; this separation does not certify the upstream estimator's training membership.
chinese: 两个此前已检查的评价队列为A20（20名参与者；1,650,789个有效测量--估计配对）和N80（80名参与者；7,111,408个配对）。两队列分别分析，重复检查后不将其视为独立确认。选择评分器开发参与者与报告的评价参与者不同，但这种分离不能认证上游估计器的训练成员独立性。

english: The exact training records associated with the released upstream checkpoint could not be established. Public training metadata contain train records for 70 of 80 N80 participants and 16 of 20 A20 participants, but metadata overlap does not by itself prove exposure of the actual checkpoint. We therefore make no verified upstream unseen-participant generalization claim.
chinese: 无法建立与发布的上游checkpoint对应的精确训练记录。公开训练元数据中，N80的70/80名和A20的16/20名参与者具有train记录，但元数据交集本身不能证明实际checkpoint暴露。因此，本研究不提出已验证的上游未见参与者泛化主张。

english: Participants, not blocks, are the statistical units. Method differences are calculated within each participant before taking the median. Descriptive 95\% intervals for paired median effects use 10,000 participant-level bootstrap resamples. Consumers and retention budgets share participants and are dependent comparisons; the intervals are pointwise descriptive summaries rather than family-wise simultaneous confidence statements. Balanced comparisons use only jointly evaluable participants and report their counts.
chinese: 统计单位是参与者，而非块。方法差异先在每名参与者内计算，再取中位数。配对中位数效应的描述性95\%区间采用10,000次参与者级bootstrap重抽样。消费者和保留预算共享参与者，比较之间存在依赖；这些区间是逐项描述性汇总，而不是控制全族的同时置信声明。平衡比较仅使用共同可评价的参与者，并报告人数。

english: Pose substitution changed decisions for every frozen consumer. Without rejection, N80 participant-median disagreement ranged from 16.43\% for SHOW instruction to 43.05\% for CeTI posture (Table~\ref{tab:overall}). The variation shows that different consumers can respond differently to the same paired target pose inputs.
chinese: 姿态替换改变了每个冻结消费者的决策。在不拒判时，N80参与者中位数不一致率从SHOW指令的16.43\%到CeTI姿态的43.05\%不等（表~\ref{tab:overall}）。这一差异表明，同一组配对目标姿态输入也可能使不同消费者产生不同反应。

english: Reference-class support was already uneven before selection. All fixed classes met the predefined minimum in 22/80 participants for DB9 posture and 79/80 for KIN phase, versus 80/80 for the other four consumers. These differences matter when interpreting class-balanced outcomes after rejection.
chinese: 选择前的参考类别支持已经不均衡。DB9姿态的22/80名和KIN阶段的79/80名参与者满足所有固定类别的预设最低支持量，另外四个消费者均为80/80。这些差异影响拒判后类别平衡结果的解释。

english: Full/U ranking reduced overall disagreement across all six consumers in N80 at 30\% offline retention. Relative to Boundary, the median within-participant reduction ranged from 1.867 percentage points for DB9 grasp (95\% descriptive bootstrap interval: 1.431--2.371) to 4.651 points for DB9 posture (2.784--6.505). All six pointwise intervals were above zero (Table~\ref{tab:overall}).
chinese: 在30\%离线保留率下，Full/U在N80的六个消费者上均降低了整体不一致率。相对Boundary，参与者内下降量的中位数从DB9抓握的1.867个百分点（95\%描述性bootstrap区间：1.431--2.371）到DB9姿态的4.651个百分点（2.784--6.505）不等。六个逐项区间均位于零以上（表~\ref{tab:overall}）。

english: Across the four tested retention budgets, Full/U showed positive median paired improvements over Boundary in all 24 consumer--budget comparisons within each of A20 and N80 (Fig.~\ref{fig:ranking}). These comparisons share participants and related experimental conditions, so the direction counts are descriptive rather than independent confirmations.
chinese: 在四个保留预算下，Full/U相对Boundary在A20和N80各自全部24项消费者--预算比较中均呈现正向配对中位数改善（图~\ref{fig:ranking}）。这些比较共享参与者及相关实验条件，因此方向计数仅为描述性结果，而非独立确认。

english: Direct paired comparisons favored Full/U over Score-only/U in 23/24 N80 and 22/24 A20 consumer--budget settings, with non-improving conditions retained in the analysis. For CeTI grasp at 30\% retention in N80, the direct within-participant Full/U improvement over Score-only/U was 3.790 percentage points (95\% descriptive bootstrap interval: 2.774--4.691; n=80).
chinese: 直接配对比较在N80的23/24项和A20的22/24项消费者--预算配置中支持Full/U优于Score-only/U，分析中保留了没有改善的配置。对于N80、30\%保留率下的CeTI抓握，Full/U相对Score-only/U的直接参与者内改善为3.790个百分点，95\%描述性bootstrap区间为2.774--4.691，n=80。

english: Feature-group contributions depended on the consumer. At 30\% retention, conditional gains from fixed-view augmentation ranged from 0.040 to 0.226 pp; four of six pointwise intervals included zero. These exploratory analyses used previously examined cohorts and did not change the original Full/U models.
chinese: 特征组的贡献依赖消费者。在30\%保留率下，固定视图增强的条件收益为0.040--0.226个百分点；六个逐项区间中有四个包含零。这些探索性分析使用此前已检查的队列，没有改变原Full/U模型。

english: Fixed-threshold criteria were met by 4/24 auxiliary Score-only configurations (0/12 balanced-targeted) and by the original Full models for 3/6 overall-risk and 0/6 balanced-risk configurations.
chinese: 固定阈值标准在4/24项辅助Score-only配置中满足，其中平衡目标为0/12；原Full模型的整体风险配置为3/6，平衡风险配置为0/6。

english: The next question is whether this overall improvement also preserves decisions across reference classes. At 30\% offline retention, Full/U reduced overall disagreement relative to Boundary across all six consumers, but class-balanced outcomes varied (Fig.~\ref{fig:fidelity}).
chinese: 接下来的问题是，整体改善能否也保持各参考类别的决策。在30\%离线保留率下，Full/U相对Boundary在六个消费者上均降低了整体不一致率，但类别平衡结果各不相同（图~\ref{fig:fidelity}）。

english: SHOW instruction revealed a clear trade-off. Among the same 79 participants with complete reference-class support, Full/U reduced overall disagreement by a median of 2.608 percentage points (95\% descriptive bootstrap interval: 1.708--2.960), while class-balanced disagreement increased by 20.880 points (12.280--27.156). Thus, an aggregate improvement coincided with substantially worse class-balanced performance within the same participants. In contrast, CeTI grasp improved both overall and class-balanced disagreement by 4.261 and 18.31 points, respectively, with all 80 participants evaluable.
chinese: SHOW指令体现了清晰的权衡。在同一组具有完整参考类别支持的79名参与者中，Full/U将整体不一致率的中位数降低了2.608个百分点，95\%描述性bootstrap区间为1.708--2.960；类别平衡不一致率却增加了20.880个百分点，区间为12.280--27.156。因此，同一组参与者中的总体改善伴随着较大的类别平衡性能恶化。相比之下，CeTI抓握的整体及类别平衡不一致率分别改善4.261和18.31个百分点，80名参与者均可评价。

english: Selection also reduced the number of participants for whom class-balanced disagreement could be evaluated. For DB9 posture, complete reference-class support was available in 22 of 80 participants without rejection, but only three under Full/U at 30\% retention. Its class-balanced comparison therefore describes only three jointly evaluable participants, not the full cohort. Together, these findings show why overall disagreement, class-balanced disagreement, and reference-class support must be interpreted jointly.
chinese: 选择还减少了能够评价类别平衡不一致率的参与者人数。DB9姿态在不拒判时有22/80名参与者具有完整参考类别支持；采用Full/U并保留30\%后，仅剩三名。其类别平衡比较因此仅描述三名共同可评价参与者，而非完整队列。这些结果共同说明，必须联合解释整体不一致率、类别平衡不一致率与参考类别支持量。

english: A shared pose interface should be evaluated not only by whether a downstream model can accept its inputs, but also by whether the model preserves its decisions. Across six frozen consumers, learned offline ranking reduced overall disagreement, yet its class-level consequences were not uniformly beneficial.
chinese: 共享姿态接口不仅应依据下游模型能否接收其输入来评价，还应依据模型能否保持其决策来评价。在六个冻结消费者中，学习型离线排序降低了整体不一致率，但其类别层面的后果并非一致有利。

english: The distinction arises because overall disagreement weights reference classes according to their frequency among retained, reference-valid blocks, whereas class-balanced disagreement gives each class equal weight. Improving one measure therefore does not guarantee improving the other. SHOW instruction illustrates this divergence within the same 79 evaluable participants, although the experiment does not establish the specific mechanism behind it. DB9 posture reveals a different limitation: after selection, only three participants retained sufficient support for evaluating every reference class. These are distinct outcomes---worsened class-balanced disagreement and reduced evaluability---that overall disagreement alone would not reveal.
chinese: 这一区别来自两个指标的权重不同：整体不一致率依据各参考类别在保留且参考有效块中的出现频率加权，而类别平衡不一致率给每个类别相同权重。因此，改善一个指标并不保证另一个指标也改善。SHOW指令在同一组79名可评价参与者中体现了这种分歧，但实验并未确立其背后的具体机制。DB9姿态则体现了另一项限制：选择后，仅三名参与者仍具有足以评价所有参考类别的支持量。类别平衡不一致率恶化与可评价性下降是两种不同的结果，仅看整体不一致率无法揭示它们。

english: Our conclusions concern the specified frozen estimator--consumer interfaces. A flip compares two model-generated decisions rather than independently labeled action correctness. Although pose mapping, source calibration procedures, and temporal indexing were examined, cross-source absolute pose equivalence and independent residual synchronization were not established. The upstream checkpoint's actual training membership also remains unresolved. Finally, whole-record processing and participant-specific retrospective ranking do not demonstrate a deployable online rejection system.
chinese: 结论针对所研究的冻结估计器--消费者接口。翻转比较两个模型生成的决策，而非独立标注的动作正确性。尽管检查了姿态映射、源域校准流程与时间索引，跨源绝对姿态等价和独立残余同步误差仍未确立。上游checkpoint的实际训练成员同样尚未解决。此外，完整记录处理与参与者特定的回顾性排序并不能证明存在可部署的在线拒判系统。

english: Replacing measured hand pose with EMG-estimated pose changed the decisions of six frozen pose consumers. Learned offline ranking reduced overall disagreement relative to boundary-based selection, but these gains did not guarantee class-balanced improvement or sufficient reference-class support. The findings show that downstream decision fidelity should be assessed jointly through overall disagreement, class-balanced disagreement, and evaluable class support. This is evidence about specified frozen interfaces under retrospective evaluation, not a claim of target-task correctness or online deployment reliability.
chinese: 以EMG估计姿态替换测量手部姿态改变了六个冻结姿态消费者的决策。学习型离线排序相对于边界选择降低了整体不一致率，但这些收益并不保证类别平衡改善或足够的参考类别支持。下游决策保真应通过整体不一致率、类别平衡不一致率及可评价类别支持联合评估。这是关于特定冻结接口在回顾性评价下的证据，而非目标准确性或在线部署可靠性的主张。
